project_type: Full-stack monorepo: React 18 + Vite + TS frontend, Node 20 + Express + TS + Prisma backend, PostgreSQL 16 + Redis, plus new Python 3.12 FastAPI ML microservice. Helm chart + Terraform + GitHub Actions + ArgoCD for deploy.
build_system: npm per package (no workspaces). Backend: tsc -> dist, run via nodemon/ts-node. Frontend: Vite build (tsc && vite build). ML service: uvicorn (no build step; pip install). IMPORTANT path contains a space: "/Users/apple/Desktop/AWS /aws-project-coding/truckBusinessTrac" — always quote it in shell commands. All paths below are relative to that root.
test_framework: No test framework configured in either frontend or backend (no jest/vitest). Verification is type-check + build + config validation, not unit tests.
build_command: backend: `cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit` (type-check) / `npm run build` (tsc). frontend: `cd frontend && npm run build` (tsc && vite build) / `npx tsc --noEmit`. ml-service: no compile; `python3 -m py_compile <files>` for syntax; `pip3 install -r ml-service/requirements.txt --dry-run` for deps.
test_command: No unit tests. The agreed verification suite for this task is the list in `verification_instructions`.
verification_instructions: Run from workspace root (quote the path). MUST pass before done: (1) `cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit` -> 0 errors; (2) `cd frontend && npm install` -> succeeds, installs recharts; (3) `cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit` -> 0 errors; (4) `pip3 install -r ml-service/requirements.txt --dry-run` -> valid; (5) `python3 -m py_compile ml-service/app/main.py ml-service/app/models/rate_predictor.py ml-service/app/models/fuel_estimator.py ml-service/app/models/demand_forecaster.py ml-service/app/routes/predictions.py` -> 0 errors; (6) `grep -n api/predictions backend/src/index.ts` shows the mount line; (7) `grep -c 'Coming Soon' frontend/src/pages/PredictionsPage.tsx` -> 0; (8) `docker compose config >/dev/null` exits 0; (9) `helm lint helm/truckbiz` 0 failures and `helm template truckbiz ./helm/truckbiz -f helm/truckbiz/values.yaml -f helm/truckbiz/values-dev.yaml >/dev/null` exits 0; (10) `terraform fmt -check terraform/modules/ecr/main.tf terraform/modules/ecr/outputs.tf` no diff. Note: `docker-compose` (v1) is NOT installed; use `docker compose` (v2). pyyaml/yq/actionlint are NOT installed; for cd.yml YAML validity use a throwaway venv: `python3 -m venv /tmp/ylc && /tmp/ylc/bin/pip install -q pyyaml && /tmp/ylc/bin/python -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/cd.yml'))"`. terraform validate needs `terraform -chdir=terraform/environments/dev init -backend=false` first (downloads AWS provider, needs network).
snapshot_or_generated_files: backend/prisma/migrations/* are checked in (do not touch). No new generated files for Phase 3 (the ml-service joblib model is runtime-generated into ml-service/data/, gitignored except for a .gitkeep).
environment_constraints: macOS (darwin), zsh. Workspace path has a space — quote it. node_modules already installed for backend & frontend. python3 3.12 + pip3 25 available (pip is externally-managed: use a venv or --dry-run, do not pip install globally without --break-system-packages). terraform 1.15 and helm 4.2 available. Do NOT restart any dev servers. Do NOT delete or break Phase 1/2 files.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/.kiro steering present. Conventions inferred from code: keep existing formatting/style; backend routes are thin routers delegating to controllers, all protected routes use `authenticate` middleware; frontend api modules export a single object of async fns using `apiClient`; Zustand stores use `create<T>()((set) => ({...}))`. Preserve the 2026 copyright line in README.
key_patterns: Frontend auth header: api/client.ts interceptor reads localStorage 'truckbiz-auth' -> parsed.state.token -> `Authorization: Bearer ${token}`. Frontend api base: `import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || '/api'`. Markets are literal 'USA' | 'EUROPE' everywhere. Equipment types: USA = Flatbed/Dry Van/Reefer/Step Deck/Lowboy; Europe = Tautliner/Mega/Frigo/Flatbed/Coil (must match exactly). Tailwind theme colors: navy-900/800/700/600 and accent/accent-dark/accent-light (see frontend/tailwind.config.ts); UI uses rounded-2xl, shadow-sm, border-slate-100. Backend: routes mount at app.use('/api/<x>', <x>Routes); JWT via middleware/auth.ts `authenticate`. Helm: per-component subdirs under templates/; fullname helpers in _helpers.tpl; values have per-component sections + values-dev/values-prod overrides. Terraform ECR module: explicit aws_ecr_repository.<name> resources + lifecycle policies, outputs per repo. cd.yml: build & push per image with ECR_*_REPO secrets, then yq-patch values-<env>.yaml and commit.
